changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Semantic') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Semantic] ( ID bigint identity(1,1) not null, Qualifier nvarchar(250) not null, EffectiveDate datetime not null, Name nvarchar(250) not null, Description nvarchar(4000) null, Threshold int not null, [Status] int not null, [Priority] int not null, [Source] int not null, MatchType int not null, BaseType int null, RegularExpression nvarchar(max) null, ValidValues nvarchar(max) null, InvalidValues nvarchar(max) null, ValidLocales nvarchar(max) null, MinimumSamples int null, HeaderFilter nvarchar(max) null, HeaderFilterConfidence int null, Minimum decimal(18,6) null, Maximum decimal(18,6) null, MinMaxPresent bit null, JsonPayload nvarchar(max) null, CreatedBy int not null, CreatedOn datetime not null, UpdatedBy int not null, UpdatedOn datetime not null, TransactionId char(10) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Semantic] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] DESC ) ) END
alter table Semantic alter column Minimum decimal(18,6) null; alter table Semantic alter column Maximum decimal(18,6) null; alter table Semantic alter column Qualifier nvarchar(250) not null;

changeSet.sql: if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'UQ_Semantic_Qualifier_EffectiveDate') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Semantic] add constraint UQ_Semantic_Qualifier_EffectiveDate UNIQUE (Qualifier, EffectiveDate) end
